overview.heroTitle: Shams 4.0: the video Masterclass of the entire Quran
overview.heroLead: Quran Masterclass already teaches reading, listening, memorising and understanding with the Shams Method. Shams 4.0 adds what is still missing: video. A complete video Masterclass of the whole Quran – recitation, tajweed and tafsir – with hadith, Nahj al-Balagha for Shia learners, a real studio, live classes with teachers and an academy for the reciters of tomorrow.
overview.heroFree: The website stays free forever and will carry the videos.
overview.heroScene: Illustration of planned features: the video lesson on a laptop, the lesson on a phone, a live class on a tablet and a competition on Android.
overview.factSurahs: surahs, every verse with audio and tafsir
overview.factLangs: languages, Arabic and four more right-to-left
overview.factSteps: steps of the Shams Method per verse
overview.factAccount: account for the website and the app
overview.visionTitle: From reading and listening to seeing and learning
overview.visionLead: Until now, Quran Masterclass is a school you read and listen to. Shams 4.0 turns it into a school you can see: a teacher who recites, explains and corrects – for every surah, in your language, at your pace.
overview.todayBody: Quran reader with audio, the Shams Method, courses, exams and certificates, a teacher link, a community and an AI tutor – live on quranmasterclass.com and in the iOS app.
overview.nextBody: Video lessons for the entire Quran, hadith and Nahj al-Balagha, a studio, live classes and conferences, a reciter academy, competitions in good and video series of many reciters.
overview.ytLead: There are many beautiful Quran videos online. But a video alone is not a school.

yt.b: Lessons in a fixed order, from the first letter to the Masterclass recital
Every lesson, verse and review is saved – on the website and in the app
The Shams Method: listen, build up, understand, recite, review
No ads, no autoplay into unrelated content
Recordings to your teacher with feedback; live classes planned
Kids mode, age rules and moderation
14 languages; subtitles for the videos planned

overview.whoTitle: For everyone who cannot go to a Quran school
overview.whoLead: A Masterclass on video reaches people for whom a Quran school is out of reach – because of distance, work, family or health.

who.d: Villages and towns without a qualified teacher nearby.
Learning at home, with female teachers and sisters' classes.
Shift workers and parents who learn after work, fifteen minutes a day.
Starting from the first letter, in their own language, without shame.
Families far from Arabic-speaking teachers, in Europe, the Americas and Asia.
Subtitles, adjustable speed, large text and learning from home.
Kids mode, short lessons and parents who watch along.

overview.pillarsLead: Everything builds on what already works today: the Shams Method, the curriculum and the community.

pillars.d: The entire Quran on video – recitation, tajweed and tafsir, surah by surah, in lessons that build on each other. With hadith and Nahj al-Balagha for Shia learners.
An own studio with cameras, sound, lighting and editing, so that every lesson looks and sounds worthy of the Quran.
Live classes with qualified teachers – for example an Arab teacher teaching live – plus Quran conferences with subtitles.
After 4.0: training new Quran reciters with levels, studio sessions and review by masters – and video series of many reciters.
Reciter competitions by age group and country, judged blind by a fixed rubric. Nothing is staked, nothing is random.
Profiles, achievements, circles and messages – only around the Quran, without ads and without unrelated content.

overview.productLead: Shams 4.0 does not start from zero. These parts are built and live – on quranmasterclass.com and in the iOS app (real screenshots of the app).
overview.shotsNote: Real screenshots of the iOS app (German interface).

built.d: Seven steps per verse and a personal memory model with reviews after 1, 3, 7, 14, 30 and 90 days.
All 114 surahs verse by verse, several reciters, word highlighting, word-by-word meaning and tafsir with its source.
Four school stages, the Reciter Path to the Masterclass recital, Arabic A1 to C1, tajweed and hifz.
The server checks every exam; certificates carry a QR code and can be verified publicly. The highest levels only after a person has listened.
Dalil, and Hidaya for sisters: strictly bound to sources, no fatwas, only after consent and sign-in.
Biographies of renowned reciters and verified member profiles with badges, levels and achievements.
One-to-one and groups of up to 256 members with text, images, voice and video messages; encrypted on the server (AES-256-GCM), report and block everywhere, 16+.
Learners send recordings to their teacher and get feedback by rubric: makharij, tajweed, waqf and pace.
Learning circles and a league as competing in good – every feature opt-in.
The best learners worldwide and per country, visible as encouragement.
Reader and studies of Nahj al-Balagha, and a course in the sciences of hadith.
Voluntary support through Ziina (UAE) and a public list of supporters.
Including Arabic, Urdu, Persian/Dari and Pashto from right to left, and a kids mode.
iPhone and iPad, the same account as the website, financed by Pro and in-app purchases. The App Store release is pending.

overview.roadLead: An order, not a calendar. Each phase starts when its partners, teachers and scholars are in place.

road.d: First video lessons – for example Juz ʿAmma with recitation, tajweed and tafsir – in a player with chapters, progress and subtitles. Then surah by surah, hadith and Nahj al-Balagha.
The own studio with several cameras, sound, light and editing, and a production line with scholarly review before anything is published.
Live classes with teachers, a timetable, sisters' and kids' classes and the first Quran conferences.
Training new reciters: levels, auditions, studio sessions, review by masters and video series of many reciters.
Reciter competitions by age group and country, judged blind, and a yearly conference – as competing in good.

overview.fundLead: Learning stays free on the website. The app earns its own keep. Partners make the large investments possible.

fund.d: The website stays free for everyone and will carry the videos. No ads, no selling of data. Voluntary support is welcome.

fund.t: iOS app: Pro and in-app purchases
fund.d: The app is financed by Quran Masterclass Pro and in-app purchases. They pay for running the platform.
Video production, the studio, teachers, streaming servers and translation cost a lot. This is what partners make possible.

overview.useLead: We name categories, not amounts. Budgets are discussed individually and in writing.

use.d: Crew, recording, editing, colour and sound mix for every lesson.
Cameras, microphones, acoustics, lighting and a calm set.
Fair fees for teachers, reciters and the scholars who review.
Every lesson is checked before it is published.
Servers, storage, adaptive streaming and delivery worldwide.
Every video in 14 languages, Arabic first.
Classroom software, moderation, timetable and support.
Kids mode, moderation, data protection and subtitles for everyone.

overview.useNote: No amounts are published here. Any budget is part of an individual conversation.
overview.gccLead: The Gulf has the scholars, the reciters, the Islamic banks and the media houses – and with them a responsibility for how the next generation learns the Quran, here and worldwide.
overview.gccCall: We call on Islamic banks, Islamic companies, media houses and foundations in the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain and Oman – and worldwide, in Indonesia, Malaysia, Türkiye, Pakistan and beyond – to support Shams 4.0.
overview.gccDedication: For Allah, for Islam, for the Quran and for the words of the Prophet ﷺ.

now.d: The hard part of the software is built and live: method, curriculum, exams, community, 14 languages. Partner money goes into content, not experiments.

now.t: Video is how a generation learns
now.d: Young people learn with video. If they do not find a structured Quran school there, they find distraction.

now.t: Arabic first, global from day one
now.d: Right-to-left languages, Arabic fonts and calligraphy are part of the design, not an afterthought.
Developed in Dubai, operated from Sharjah – close to the scholars, reciters and partners of the region.

overview.founderBody: Nami Shams is the founder of Quran Masterclass and the developer of the Shams Method. He works on Islamic research and Islamic apps, translated Nahj al-Balagha into German and wrote books on the tafsir of Surah al-Baqara and on Imam Ali.
overview.partnerLead: Strategic Islamic companies, Islamic banks and impact investors, media houses, sponsors of course series, foundations – and renowned reciters and teachers as content partners.
overview.ctaLead: Write to us as a company, bank, media house, foundation, reciter or teacher. We answer every serious inquiry personally.

studio.heroLead: A studio built for one purpose: to record the Quran and its teaching with the dignity it deserves – clear sound, calm light and a picture that does not distract.
studio.heroScene: Illustration: editing a lesson on a laptop and the recording plan on a tablet.
studio.planTitle: One room for recitation, one for the craft
studio.planLead: The recording hall is quiet and simple: a teacher, a Quran stand, a student opposite. Three cameras, soft light, the microphone close to the voice. Next door the control room and editing.
studio.planCaption: Illustration of a possible floor plan. Not to scale.
legend: Camera A – wide shot of the teacher
Camera B – close-up of the face and the mouth for makharij
Camera C – from above onto the mushaf
Key light – soft and from the front
Back light – separates the teacher from the background
studio.kitLead: No brands and no prices here – only what the recordings need.

kit.d: Several cameras at once: wide, close-up for makharij, and from above onto the mushaf.
Recitation comes first: studio microphones, a treated room, no music and no effects.
Soft, warm light without hard shadows – calm for hours of watching.
A calm Islamic set: a mihrab-shaped backdrop, wood, a Quran stand, nothing that distracts.
Several angles, clean cuts, chapters and lower thirds in the Masterclass design.
Every recording stored safely twice, so that lessons can be improved and translated later.

studio.lineTitle: From the curriculum to the free lesson

line.d: What the lesson teaches and where it stands in the course.
The script is checked before anything is recorded.
In the studio, with several cameras and clean sound.
Cuts, chapters, the verse on screen from the Quran data – never typed by hand.
A second review of the finished video.
Free on the website; in the app with Pro features such as offline use.

rules: Sound first: every letter of the recitation must be heard clearly.
No music and no effects that distract from the Quran.
Recordings with female teachers for sisters, with a female team on request.
Every teacher and reciter records under a written agreement; nothing is published without permission.
Quran text on screen only from the Quran data, with its source.
studio.sponsorTitle: Sponsor the studio or a series
studio.sponsorLead: A partner can make the studio possible – or a complete course series, for example Juz ʿAmma, tajweed or Nahj al-Balagha.

live.heroLead: A teacher in front of a class – live, from the studio or from home. Students recite in turn, the teacher listens and corrects. For everyone who has no Quran school nearby.
live.heroScene: Illustration: a live class on a laptop, the student's turn on a phone and the waiting room on Android.

formats.d: A small circle of six to ten learners who recite in turn; the teacher hears every one.
Tafsir, hadith and Nahj al-Balagha – a teacher explains, the class asks.
Female teachers for sisters, in a closed class.
Short, joyful lessons; parents are present.
For example an Arab teacher teaching live – with subtitles for those who are still learning Arabic.
In Ramadan and beyond: talks and recitation with subtitles in many languages.

flow.d: Learners wait until the teacher lets them in.
The teacher hears each learner, one after another.
By a fixed rubric: makharij, tajweed, waqf and pace.
The verses go straight into the learner's Shams review.

live.timetableLead: Fixed times give the week a shape – like a real Quran school, only open to the whole world.
live.timetableScene: Illustration: the weekly timetable of the live school on a tablet.
live.confLead: Talks and recitation from the studio, shown worldwide, with subtitles in the languages of the audience.
live.confScene: Illustration: a Quran conference on a studio display.
safe: Age rules like today: messages and connections only from 16 on both sides.
Report and block in every class, moderation by the school.
No phone numbers or e-mail addresses are shown to other members.
Children only with a parent or guardian.
basis: Teacher link with recordings and feedback by rubric
Messenger groups of up to 256 members

academy.heroLead: After Shams 4.0 comes the next step: training new Quran reciters. Talents should emerge here, in the GCC – and everywhere the Quran is loved.
academy.heroScene: Illustration: a ranking on a phone, the blind jury on a laptop, children learning on a tablet and the academy levels on Android.

path.d: Ten levels with exams and recordings; the highest levels only after a person has listened.
Promising learners recite before a panel – online or in the studio.
Regular sessions with experienced reciters and teachers.
Recording in the studio, with feedback on voice, breath and maqam.
Graduates record their own series – with a written agreement.

academy.mentorsLead: We want to win renowned reciters as mentors and content partners. Names are only published once an agreement has been signed.
academy.compLead: Competitions that honour the Quran: fair, transparent and without anything that resembles gambling.

compRules.d: The jury hears a number, not a name or a country.
Makharij, tajweed, waqf and pace – the same rubric as in the teacher link.
Children, youth and adults; sisters and brothers; per country and worldwide.
No fees for chances, nothing random. Recognition through certificates and an invitation to the studio.

academy.verseNote: The verse speaks of those who strive for the good – the spirit of every competition here.
academy.kidsLead: Kids mode already exists. With Shams 4.0 children get short video lessons on the tablet – letters, short surahs, and parents who watch along.
academy.kidsScene: Illustration: children learning on a tablet.
academy.seriesTitle: Apps and video series for many reciters
academy.seriesLead: Every recorded reciter can get a series of their own – in the Masterclass and as a separate app. Always with the reciter's written permission.

partners.heroLead: Shams 4.0 needs partners who want to carry the Quran into the next generation – with capital, media, expertise or content.

types.d: Companies that want to stand behind Quran education: strategic partnership, technology, co-branding of series.
Islamic banks, family offices and impact investors. Shariah-compliant models can be discussed individually.
TV channels, streaming platforms and publishers: co-production, distribution and airtime.
Sponsor a complete series – for example Juz ʿAmma on video, tajweed or Nahj al-Balagha.
Renowned reciters and qualified teachers as content partners – on video or live.
Foundations, universities and Quran institutes that share the goal.
